title: Hypercohomology of a sheaf Hom complex into K-injectives
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J, R a sheaf of commutative rings, and A its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume a derived category D(A) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let I be any endofunctor of integer-indexed cochain complexes in A [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] whose objects I(M) are K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. There is an additive natural isomorphism, on the product of the opposite complex category and the complex category, between (L,M) ↦ H⁰(C,Q(Hom•(L,I(M)))) [def-pur-hom-complex] [def-pur-ringed-site-zeroth-hypercohomology] and (L,M) ↦ Hom_K(A)(L,I(M)), where K(A) is the homotopy category. The maps on the latter group are precomposition by L′ → L and postcomposition by I(M → M′). No resolution transformation, boundedness, or K-flatness of L is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 08JA (global assertion), using Lemmas 0A95 and 0A96 and Equation 0A8Z; source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08JA, /0A95, /0A96.

proof.text: Lift the target functor I to the full subcategory of K-injective complexes using hI. The first two natural isomorphisms of [lem-sfb-derived-internal-hom-sections-model] identify represented derived internal Hom with localized sheaf Hom and its derived global sections with localized ordinary sections. Invert the first comparison, apply derived sections, and compose with the second. Whisker by the lifted product functor and zeroth derived homology. The homology factorization comparison turns localized ordinary sections into ordinary zeroth global cohomology. This uses only the natural representative and full-complex comparisons, not the final all-degree derived-morphism assertion of that node.

Whisker the proved ordinary global Hom comparison [lem-pur-hom-complex-global-homotopy] by identity.prod I. Compose with the preceding isomorphism and the functor associator to obtain the natural hypercohomology-to-homotopy-Hom comparison. It applies to every functor I with K-injective values, without a resolution transformation, boundedness, or K-flatness of its source.

proof_origin.description: Compose the existing representative and full derived-global-sections natural comparisons, apply zeroth homology and its factorization, and use the proved independent-universe ordinary Hom comparison. No new hole or new node.

theorem rhom_hypercohomology_bridgeOfUniverses
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      ((sheafCompose J
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      ((sheafCompose J
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ℤ ⥤
      CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      ((sheafCompose J
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hI : ∀ M, (I.obj M).IsKInjective) :
    Nonempty (((𝟭 _).prod I ⋙ Functor.uncurry.obj (homComplexFunctor (R := R)) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ ringedSiteZerothHypercohomologyOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R) ≅
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).op).prod
          (I ⋙ HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙
        Functor.uncurry.obj preadditiveCoyoneda)
